status: Planning assumptions, not observed performance or approved commitments
time_basis: Working days, eight-hour capacity day, five working days per week; no assumed overnight or weekend productivity gain
comparison_scope: The 30 sized original tickets plus explicitly additional fleet setup. Original ERP link, phone UI and release verification remain unsized and outside like-for-like savings, with dependencies retained in a separate scope register.
scenario_parameter_meaning: Execution/rework multipliers apply to new judgement estimates of agent and human work, not to original Engineer days. Capacity is an assumed available resource, not measured throughput.

recurring_fleet_coordination.rule: Reserve these within each scenario's assigned human capacity. Schedule task/setup phases using remaining capacity. Add reserved FTE times scenario elapsed working days to human effort and savings calculations as explicit recurring coordination/operations effort, including waiting periods. Per-ticket effort covers task-specific work, not this cross-fleet reserve.

role_pool_rule: Engineer, Principal and operator pools assume independently available capacity, not separate full-time hires. If roles share a person, allocations must fit individual availability and conflicting assignments must be prevented before approving dates.

physical_resources.rule: Identical physical readiness and prototype/fixture counts in all primary scenarios. Scenario target_slots counts basic development-board stations only. One prototype/plant pool is held exclusively for integration, control acceptance, dry-out and soak; a separate fixture supports provisioning. Sensitivities vary hardware readiness separately.

human_review_policy.rule: Principal ticket effort covers human approval of every merge plus engineering decisions. Increase raw ticket allowances by 50% for initial policy; never reduce review effort for stretch. Also show a sensitivity retaining 15.2 Principal days of ticket review before setup and recurring coordination.

physical_duration_rule: Target active, fixed observation and hands-on operator durations are never reduced by software scenario multipliers. Physical acceptance Engineer effort is not reduced for stretch.
decision_latency_rule: A common initial two-working-day contract/permission allowance gates product briefing and can overlap environment setup. It does not gate every setup activity or imply all stakeholder questions are answered. Sensitivity ten days; unresolved later decisions remain additional risk.

cautious.description: Restricted human capacity and one basic board station; same prototype/fixture readiness as other scenarios

target.description: Six execution slots, two basic board stations, one shared prototype and one production fixture

stretch.description: Higher usable software concurrency and human capacity; same prototype/fixture count and readiness

fixed_physical_duration_allowances.status: Unconfirmed allowances held constant across scenarios, not source requirements, measured durations or permission to shorten actual tests

setup_target_estimates.status: Judgement allowances include configuration plus governance/authority assignment, security boundary review, versioned task/evidence/reservation records, controlled target access and first-wave forecast analysis. Main effort comprises original configuration E2/P0.5 plus governance E1/P0.5, durable records E1/P0.25, security E0.5/P0.25, exclusivity/access E0.5/P0.25 and forecast analysis E0.5/P0.25. Enforce exclusivity through dedicated target-owning host accounts and serialised access, not ompc session leases. Suitable machine reuse assumed; purchasing lead time, quotes and generic platform development excluded. Target commissioning waits for each resource type's ready date.

cost_basis.rule: Report effort savings and break-even allowance algebraically. Do not invent currency savings. Include setup, extra equipment, model costs and ongoing operations when rates become available.

unconfirmed_conditions: Main computer capacity and model/provider quotas support the proposed concurrent sessions
Target slots represent distinct usable hardware and attached peripherals, not several agents sharing one target
Physical test durations and hardware delivery dates require supplier and test-owner confirmation
Human capacity includes project briefing, review, integration and acceptance; external stakeholder decision delays are not known
Only existing ompc primitives plus a documented project workflow are assumed; generic platform feature development must be added explicitly if required
Original personal-agent productivity assumption is unresolved; savings compare with the user-confirmed 101.4-day estimate, not a measured control
